name: mhrvatin
description: Marcus Hrvatin's personal Claude Code commands, agents, and skills.

plugins.name: mhr
plugins.description: Personal workflow commands (pr, interview, to-tickets, implement, todo-minor), review agents (code-reviewer, security-auditor [opus], architect-reviewer) plus working agents (sql-pro, devops-engineer, pr, ci-fixer), and skills (test-driven-development, mockup).

plugins.name: mhr-guardrails
plugins.description: Command-safety PreToolUse guards: blocks npx/bunx-style runners, broad `git add`, `--no-verify`, force-push, commits on protected branches, staging secret files, and (best-effort) reading .env files.

plugins.name: mhr-worktree
plugins.description: Git worktree isolation workflow: require edits inside a worktree, block escaping back to the main checkout, and auto-provision a worktree on entry / tear it down on exit.

plugins.name: mhr-pinning
plugins.description: Blocks non-exact dependency version ranges in package.json and unpinned GitHub Actions.
